<style data-from="共用.css">
@font-face { font-family: 'ZCOOL KuaiLe'; src: url('../字体/ZCOOLKuaiLe-Regular.ttf') format('truetype'); font-display: swap; }
@font-face { font-family: 'EldredPixel'; src: url('../字体/艾尔德雷德像素字体.woff2') format('woff2'); font-display: swap; }

:root {
  --sky: #8fd3ff; --sky2: #4aa8f0; --royal: #2257b5; --royal2: #163c86; --ink: #1b2745;
  --gold: #f5c451; --gold2: #d99a1f; --cream: #fff8ea; --paper: #fbefd5;
  --coral: #ff6b6b; --mint: #3fcf9b; --lilac: #9b7bff; --white: #fff;
  --text: #2a3350; --muted: #55668f;
  --r-lg: 24px; --r-md: 16px; --r-sm: 10px;
  --ring: 0 0 0 3px #fff, 0 0 0 6px var(--gold), 0 0 0 8px var(--royal);
  --glow: 0 12px 32px rgba(34, 87, 181, .30);
  --display: 'ZCOOL KuaiLe', 'Noto Sans SC', 'Microsoft YaHei UI', 'Microsoft YaHei', 'PingFang SC', sans-serif;
  --body: 'Noto Sans SC', 'Microsoft YaHei UI', 'Microsoft YaHei', 'PingFang SC', system-ui, sans-serif;
  --px: 'EldredPixel', 'ZCOOL KuaiLe', 'Noto Sans SC', 'Microsoft YaHei', monospace;
  --outline: 0 2px 0 var(--ink), 2px 0 0 var(--ink), -2px 0 0 var(--ink), 0 -2px 0 var(--ink), 2px 2px 0 var(--ink), -2px 2px 0 var(--ink);
}
*, *::before, *::after { box-sizing: border-box; }
html, body { margin: 0; height: 100%; }
body {
  display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; overflow: hidden;
  font-family: var(--body); color: var(--ink); -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent;
  user-select: none; -webkit-user-select: none; touch-action: manipulation;
  background: linear-gradient(180deg, #bfe6ff, #8fcdf6 55%, #6fb4ea);
}
body::before { content: ''; position: fixed; left: 0; top: 0; width: 100%; height: 100%; pointer-events: none; opacity: .45;
  background: repeating-linear-gradient(45deg, rgba(255,255,255,.16) 0 22px, transparent 22px 44px), repeating-linear-gradient(-45deg, rgba(255,255,255,.16) 0 22px, transparent 22px 44px); }
button { font: inherit; color: inherit; cursor: pointer; touch-action: manipulation; }
img { -webkit-user-drag: none; }
[hidden] { display: none !important; }
.hidden { display: none !important; }

.mg-frame {
  position: relative; width: min(100vw, 430px); height: 100vh; height: 100dvh; max-height: 900px; overflow: hidden;
  display: flex; flex-direction: column; isolation: isolate; background: var(--royal2);
}
@media (min-width: 470px) and (min-height: 640px) {
  .mg-frame { height: min(calc(100dvh - 36px), 900px); border-radius: 28px; box-shadow: var(--ring), 0 24px 60px rgba(10, 30, 70, .45); }
}

.mg-hud { position: relative; z-index: 30; flex: none; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: calc(10px + env(safe-area-inset-top)) 12px 6px; }
.mg-hud .mg-spacer { flex: 1 1 auto; }
.mg-plate {
  display: inline-flex; align-items: baseline; gap: 7px; min-height: 44px; padding: 5px 14px 5px 12px; border-radius: 999px;
  background: linear-gradient(#2a5fb8, #163c86); color: #fff; white-space: nowrap;
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px var(--gold), 0 4px 0 2px rgba(27,39,69,.6);
}
.mg-plate small { font: 13px var(--display); color: #ffe9a8; letter-spacing: .06em; }
.mg-plate b { font: 22px/1 var(--px); font-weight: 400; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; min-width: 2ch; text-align: center; text-shadow: 0 2px 0 rgba(0,0,0,.35); }
.mg-plate b.bump { animation: mg-bump .28s ease-out; }
@keyframes mg-bump { 0% { transform: scale(1); } 40% { transform: scale(1.35); color: var(--gold); } 100% { transform: scale(1); } }
.mg-plate.warn { background: linear-gradient(#d9414f, #a8313d); box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px #ffb3b3, 0 4px 0 2px rgba(27,39,69,.6); }

.mg-round {
  flex: none; width: 46px; height: 46px; display: grid; place-items: center; padding: 0; border: 0; border-radius: 50%;
  background: linear-gradient(#fffaf0, #f4e6c4); color: var(--ink);
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px #fff, 0 0 0 4px var(--gold), 0 4px 0 4px rgba(27,39,69,.6); transition: transform .12s, box-shadow .12s;
}
.mg-round:active { transform: translateY(2px); box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px #fff, 0 0 0 4px var(--gold), 0 2px 0 4px rgba(27,39,69,.6); }
.mg-round svg { width: 24px; height: 24px; display: block; }
.mg-round.back { font: 26px/1 var(--display); padding-bottom: 3px; }

.mg-timer { position: relative; z-index: 30; flex: none; height: 16px; margin: 0 12px; border-radius: 999px; overflow: hidden;
  background: rgba(27,39,69,.72); box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px #fff, 0 0 0 3px rgba(27,39,69,.5); }
.mg-timer i { position: absolute; left: 0; top: 0; height: 100%; width: 100%; display: block; border-radius: 999px;
  background: linear-gradient(180deg, #fff0a8, #f5c451 55%, #e0a21e); transform-origin: left center; transition: background .3s; }
.mg-timer.low i, .mg-timer i.low { background: linear-gradient(180deg, #ff9a9a, #ff6b6b 55%, #d9414f); }
.mg-timer span { position: absolute; right: 8px; top: 0; line-height: 16px; font: 12px/16px var(--px); color: #fff; text-shadow: 0 1px 0 var(--ink), 1px 0 0 var(--ink), -1px 0 0 var(--ink), 0 -1px 0 var(--ink); }

.mg-screen {
  position: absolute; inset: 0; z-index: 60; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; padding: 26px 14px 16px;
  background: rgba(12, 28, 70, .58); backdrop-filter: blur(3px); -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(3px); overflow-y: auto; overflow-x: hidden;
}
.mg-card {
  position: relative; width: 100%; max-width: 360px; margin: auto; padding: 24px 18px 16px; text-align: center; border-radius: var(--r-lg);
  background: radial-gradient(ellipse at top, #fffdf7, #fff6e4 60%, var(--paper)); color: var(--text);
  box-shadow: var(--ring), 0 18px 40px rgba(0,0,0,.35); animation: mg-rise .4s cubic-bezier(.2, 1.2, .35, 1);
}
@keyframes mg-rise { from { transform: translateY(26px) scale(.92); opacity: 0; } to { transform: none; opacity: 1; } }
.mg-kicker {
  position: absolute; left: 50%; top: 0; transform: translate(-50%, -58%); z-index: 2; white-space: nowrap;
  display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; padding: 4px 16px 5px; border-radius: 999px; font: 15px var(--display); color: #fff;
  background: linear-gradient(180deg, #5fb0f0, #2d73d6 22%, #245fc0);
  text-shadow: 0 2px 0 var(--royal2), 1px 0 0 var(--royal2), -1px 0 0 var(--royal2), 0 1px 0 var(--royal2), 0 -1px 0 var(--royal2);
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px #fff, 0 0 0 4px var(--gold), 0 4px 0 4px rgba(27,39,69,.8);
}
.mg-kicker::before, .mg-kicker::after { content: ''; width: 8px; height: 8px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--gold); box-shadow: inset 0 -2px 0 rgba(27,39,69,.35); }
.mg-art {
  position: relative; width: 96px; height: 96px; margin: 2px auto 6px; padding: 4px; border-radius: 50%;
  background: conic-gradient(from 210deg, #fff6cf, #f5c451, #d99a1f, #fff6cf); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px #fff, 0 0 0 5px var(--royal), 0 6px 0 5px rgba(27,39,69,.55);
}
.mg-art > .in { position: relative; width: 100%; height: 100%; border-radius: 50%; overflow: hidden; display: grid; place-items: center;
  background: radial-gradient(circle at 50% 35%, #fff, #cfe8ff); }
.mg-art img { display: block; width: 78%; height: 78%; object-fit: contain; filter: drop-shadow(0 3px 0 rgba(27,39,69,.25)); }
.mg-art .sprite, .mg-art .player { position: absolute; left: 50%; top: 0; margin-left: -48px; width: 96px; height: 128px; image-rendering: pixelated; }
.mg-art.free { width: auto; height: auto; padding: 0; background: none; box-shadow: none; border-radius: 0; }
.mg-art.sm { width: 76px; height: 76px; }
.mg-art.sm .sprite { transform: scale(1) translateY(-4px); }

.mg-title { margin: 4px 0 6px; font: 34px/1.15 var(--display); font-weight: 400; color: var(--royal2); letter-spacing: .04em; text-wrap: balance; }
.mg-title em { font-style: normal; color: #d9414f; }
.mg-h2 { margin: 2px 0 4px; font: 24px/1.2 var(--display); font-weight: 400; color: var(--royal2); }
.mg-lead { margin: 0 0 12px; font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.6; color: var(--text); text-wrap: pretty; }
.mg-lead b { color: #a8650c; font-weight: 700; }
.mg-sub { margin: 0 0 6px; font: 15px var(--display); color: var(--muted); }

.mg-btn {
  display: block; width: 100%; min-height: 56px; margin: 8px auto 0; padding: 8px 24px; border: 0; border-radius: 999px;
  font: 26px/1.2 var(--display); letter-spacing: .18em; text-indent: .18em; color: #5c3604;
  background: linear-gradient(180deg, #fff3b0, #f7c84f 50%, #e8a526);
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px #fff, 0 0 0 5px #e8a526, 0 7px 0 5px #9a620f; transition: transform .12s, box-shadow .12s;
}
.mg-btn:active { transform: translateY(4px); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px #fff, 0 0 0 5px #e8a526, 0 3px 0 5px #9a620f; }
.mg-btn.alt { color: var(--royal); background: linear-gradient(180deg, #fff, #e6f2ff); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px #fff, 0 0 0 5px #9fcbf5, 0 7px 0 5px #6f95c7; }
.mg-btn.alt:active { box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px #fff, 0 0 0 5px #9fcbf5, 0 3px 0 5px #6f95c7; }
.mg-btn.sm { min-height: 48px; font-size: 20px; letter-spacing: .08em; text-indent: .08em; padding: 6px 18px; }
.mg-btn:focus-visible, .mg-round:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--royal); outline-offset: 6px; }
.mg-btns { display: flex; gap: 10px; margin-top: 10px; }
.mg-btns .mg-btn { flex: 1 1 0; width: auto; margin-top: 0; min-width: 0; padding: 8px 12px; font-size: 23px; letter-spacing: .1em; text-indent: .1em; white-space: nowrap; }
.mg-btns .mg-btn.alt { flex: 0 0 auto; font-size: 20px; letter-spacing: .04em; text-indent: .04em; padding: 8px 16px; }

.mg-label { margin: 0; font: 14px var(--display); color: var(--muted); letter-spacing: .1em; }
.mg-score-big { margin: 2px 0 0; font: 64px/1 var(--px); color: var(--royal); text-shadow: 0 4px 0 rgba(27,39,69,.16); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
.mg-score-big small { font: 20px var(--display); color: var(--muted); margin-left: 4px; }
.mg-newrec, .newrec, .newbest {
  display: inline-block; margin: 6px 0 2px; padding: 2px 14px 3px; border-radius: 999px; font: 15px var(--display); color: #fff;
  background: linear-gradient(#cc2f3c, #b01f2b); box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px #fff, 0 3px 0 2px rgba(27,39,69,.8); transform: rotate(-3deg); animation: mg-sticker .5s cubic-bezier(.2, 1.6, .4, 1);
}
@keyframes mg-sticker { from { transform: rotate(-3deg) scale(1.6); opacity: 0; } to { transform: rotate(-3deg) scale(1); opacity: 1; } }
.mg-verdict { margin: 10px 4px 8px; font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.6; color: var(--text); text-wrap: balance; }
.mg-stats { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; justify-content: center; gap: 6px 6px; margin: 0 0 12px; padding: 0; list-style: none; }
.mg-stats span, .mg-stats .stat { display: inline-flex; align-items: baseline; gap: 5px; padding: 3px 10px; border-radius: 999px; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--royal); background: #fff;
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px #cfe6ff, 0 3px 0 2px rgba(27,39,69,.22); white-space: nowrap; }
.mg-stats .stat small { font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--royal); }
.mg-stats .stat span, .mg-stats .stat b { padding: 0; box-shadow: none; background: none; font: 15px/1 var(--px); color: var(--royal2); }
.mg-best { margin: 10px 0 0; font-size: 13px; color: var(--muted); }
.mg-best b { font-family: var(--px); font-weight: 400; color: var(--royal); font-size: 14px; }
.mg-egg { margin: 10px 0 0; font-size: 12px; line-height: 1.5; color: var(--muted); }

.mg-rules { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr); gap: 6px; margin: 8px 0 14px; }
.mg-rules > div { padding: 6px 2px 5px; border-radius: 12px; background: #fff; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px #cfe6ff, 0 3px 0 2px rgba(27,39,69,.18); font-size: 12px; line-height: 1.15; color: var(--text); font-weight: 700; }
.mg-rules i { display: block; height: 44px; margin-bottom: 2px; background: center / contain no-repeat; }
.mg-rules b { display: block; font: 18px/1.1 var(--px); color: #0f7a52; margin-bottom: 2px; }
.mg-rules .minus b { color: #d9414f; }

.mg-seg { display: flex; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; margin: 4px 0 10px; }
.mg-seg button { flex: 1 1 0; min-width: 0; min-height: 56px; padding: 6px 4px; border: 0; border-radius: 14px; background: #fff; color: var(--muted);
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px #cfe6ff, 0 3px 0 2px rgba(27,39,69,.18); line-height: 1.2; }
.mg-seg button strong { display: block; font: 18px var(--display); font-weight: 400; }
.mg-seg button small { display: block; font: 12px var(--px); margin-top: 2px; }
.mg-seg button[aria-pressed="true"] { color: #5c3604; background: linear-gradient(180deg, #fff3b0, #f7c84f 50%, #e8a526); box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px #fff, 0 0 0 4px #e8a526, 0 4px 0 4px #9a620f; }

.mg-say {
  position: relative; padding: 7px 12px 8px; border-radius: 14px; background: var(--cream); color: var(--text); font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.35;
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px var(--ink), 0 3px 0 2px rgba(27,39,69,.45);
}
.mg-float { position: absolute; white-space: nowrap; pointer-events: none; font: 24px/1 var(--display); color: #fff; text-shadow: var(--outline); }
.mg-float.good { color: var(--gold); }
.mg-float.bad { color: #ff8a8a; }
.mg-tag { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; padding: 2px 9px; border-radius: 999px; font: 12px var(--display); color: #fff;
  background: rgba(27,39,69,.72); box-shadow: 0 0 0 1.5px rgba(255,255,255,.55); white-space: nowrap; }
.mg-combo { font: 24px var(--display); color: var(--gold); text-shadow: var(--outline); }

@media (max-height: 700px) {
  .mg-card { padding: 20px 14px 14px; }
  .mg-art { width: 76px; height: 76px; margin-bottom: 4px; }
  .mg-title { font-size: 28px; }
  .mg-lead { font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.5; margin-bottom: 10px; }
  .mg-btn { min-height: 52px; font-size: 24px; }
  .mg-score-big { font-size: 52px; }
  .mg-rules i { height: 38px; }
  .mg-seg button { min-height: 50px; }
}
@media (max-width: 340px) {
  .mg-hud { padding-left: 8px; padding-right: 8px; gap: 6px; }
  .mg-timer { margin: 0 8px; }
  .mg-plate { padding: 5px 11px 5px 10px; gap: 5px; }
  .mg-plate small { font-size: 12px; }
  .mg-plate b { font-size: 20px; }
  .mg-screen { padding: 24px 8px 12px; }
  .mg-card { padding-left: 12px; padding-right: 12px; }
  .mg-kicker { font-size: 13px; padding: 3px 12px 4px; }
  .mg-title { font-size: 26px; }
  .mg-btns { gap: 8px; }
}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  .mg-card, .mg-newrec, .mg-plate b.bump { animation: none !important; }
}

</style>
<style data-from="yard.css">
.yard { background: linear-gradient(180deg, var(--sky1, #9fd8ff) 0%, var(--sky2, #d7f0ff) 38%, var(--sky3, #e9f7ff) 100%); }
@media (min-width: 470px) { .mg-frame.yard { width: 480px; } }
.world { position: relative; flex: 1 1 auto; min-height: 0; display: flex; flex-direction: column; }
.ground { position: absolute; left: 0; right: 0; top: var(--horizon, 50%); bottom: 0; background-color: #6fbd45; background-repeat: repeat; background-position: 0 0; image-rendering: pixelated; filter: var(--gfilter, blur(.5px) saturate(.92)); }
.ground::before { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 0; right: 0; top: 0; height: 3px; background: rgba(255,255,255,.35); }
body::before { z-index: 0; }

.mg-timer.xp { height: 22px; margin-bottom: 6px; }
.mg-timer.xp i { transition: width .35s ease-out; transform: none; }
.mg-timer.xp span { left: 12px; right: auto; font: 13px/22px var(--display); letter-spacing: .04em; max-width: calc(100% - 24px); overflow: hidden; white-space: nowrap; text-overflow: ellipsis; }
.mg-plate.lv b { min-width: 1.4ch; }

.scene { position: relative; z-index: 1; flex: 1 1 182px; min-height: 182px; overflow: hidden; }
.cloud { position: absolute; height: 14px; border-radius: 99px; background: #fff; opacity: .9; box-shadow: 14px -8px 0 -2px #fff, 30px 0 0 -1px #fff; }
.cloud.c1 { left: 9%; top: 14%; width: 44px; animation: drift 38s linear infinite alternate; }
.cloud.c2 { left: 62%; top: 26%; width: 34px; animation: drift 52s linear infinite alternate-reverse; }
@keyframes drift { from { transform: translateX(-12px); } to { transform: translateX(26px); } }
.house { position: absolute; right: 6%; bottom: 40%; image-rendering: pixelated; z-index: 1; }
.fence { position: absolute; left: 0; right: 0; bottom: 0; z-index: 1; background-repeat: repeat-x; background-position: 0 100%; image-rendering: pixelated; pointer-events: none; }
.sign {
  position: absolute; left: 4%; top: 10px; z-index: 3; max-width: 52%; min-height: 44px; padding: 6px 14px 7px; border: 0; border-radius: 10px;
  font: 17px/1.2 var(--display); color: #fff3d0; letter-spacing: .06em; text-shadow: 0 2px 0 #4a2f18;
  background: linear-gradient(180deg, #a8703c, #8a5a2f 60%, #74481f);
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px #4a2f18, inset 0 2px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.25), 0 5px 0 2px rgba(27,39,69,.4);
  transform-origin: 50% -6px; animation: sway 4.2s ease-in-out infinite;
}
.sign::before, .sign::after { content: ''; position: absolute; top: -9px; width: 3px; height: 10px; background: #4a2f18; }
.sign::before { left: 18px; } .sign::after { right: 18px; }
.sign span { display: block; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; }
@keyframes sway { 0%, 100% { transform: rotate(-1.2deg); } 50% { transform: rotate(1.2deg); } }

.lane { --ps: 1; position: absolute; left: 0; right: 0; bottom: 2px; height: calc(128px * var(--ps)); pointer-events: none; z-index: 2; }
.who { position: absolute; bottom: 0; left: var(--x, 20%); width: calc(96px * var(--ps)); height: calc(128px * var(--ps)); margin-left: calc(-48px * var(--ps)); transition: left var(--walk, 1.6s) linear; }
.who .shadow { position: absolute; left: 50%; bottom: 0; width: calc(58px * var(--ps)); height: calc(12px * var(--ps)); margin-left: calc(-29px * var(--ps)); border-radius: 50%; background: rgba(27,39,69,.28); }
.player { position: absolute; inset: 0; background: url("素材/player-idle.png") 0 0 / calc(768px * var(--ps)) 100% no-repeat; image-rendering: pixelated;
  animation: idle .96s steps(8) infinite; transform-origin: 50% 100%; }
@keyframes idle { from { background-position-x: 0; } to { background-position-x: calc(-768px * var(--ps)); } }
.who.mirror .player { transform: scaleX(-1); }
.who.walking .player { animation: idle .96s steps(8) infinite, step .32s ease-in-out infinite; }
@keyframes step { 0%, 100% { translate: 0 0; } 50% { translate: 0 -5px; } }
.player.hop { animation: idle .96s steps(8) infinite, hop .42s cubic-bezier(.3, .9, .4, 1); }
@keyframes hop { 0% { translate: 0 0; } 40% { translate: 0 -22px; } 100% { translate: 0 0; } }
.who .say { position: absolute; left: 50%; bottom: calc(132px * var(--ps)); transform: translateX(-50%); width: max-content; max-width: 210px; z-index: 5;
  padding: 6px 11px 7px; border-radius: 14px; background: var(--cream); color: var(--text); font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.35; text-align: center;
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px var(--ink), 0 3px 0 2px rgba(27,39,69,.4); animation: pop .25s cubic-bezier(.2, 1.4, .4, 1); }
.who .say::after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 50%; bottom: -8px; margin-left: -6px; border: 6px solid transparent; border-top-color: var(--ink); border-bottom: 0; }
@keyframes pop { from { transform: translateX(-50%) scale(.7); opacity: 0; } to { transform: translateX(-50%) scale(1); opacity: 1; } }

.field-wrap { flex: none; padding: 0 12px 2px; position: relative; z-index: 1; }
.field {
  display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(4, var(--cell, 74px)); justify-content: center; gap: 6px; padding: 8px; margin: 0 auto; width: max-content; max-width: 100%; border-radius: 16px;
  background: #8a5a2f; background-image: var(--mud, repeating-linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(0,0,0,.08) 0 3px, transparent 3px 22px)); background-size: var(--mud-s, auto); image-rendering: pixelated;
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px #4a2f18, inset 0 3px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.18), 0 6px 0 3px rgba(27,39,69,.35);

function thumbMetrics(scrollSize        , clientSize        , scrollPos        , trackLength        , minThumb = SCROLLBAR_MIN_THUMB)                                                      {
  if (!(scrollSize > clientSize + 1) || !(clientSize > 0) || !(trackLength > 0)) return { hidden: true, length: 0, offset: 0 };
  const length = Math.min(trackLength, Math.max(minThumb, Math.round((trackLength * clientSize) / scrollSize)));
  const maxScroll = scrollSize - clientSize;
  const ratio = Math.min(1, Math.max(0, (Number(scrollPos) || 0) / maxScroll));
  return { hidden: false, length, offset: Math.round((trackLength - length) * ratio) };
}

function needsCustomBar(win                           )          {
  if (!win) return false;
  try {
    if (typeof win.matchMedia === 'function') return !!win.matchMedia(SCROLLBAR_MEDIA).matches;
  } catch {
  }
  return false;
}

function ensureScrollbarStyle(doc          )       {
  if (doc.getElementById(SCROLLBAR_STYLE_ID)) return;
  const style = doc.createElement('style');
  style.id = SCROLLBAR_STYLE_ID;
  style.textContent = SCROLLBAR_CSS;
  (doc.head ?? doc.documentElement).appendChild(style);
}


function dragScrollPos(input                                                                                                                                               )                                       {
  const { pointer, trackStart, trackLength, thumbStart, thumbLength, scrollSize, clientSize } = input;
  const maxScroll = scrollSize - clientSize;
  const room = trackLength - thumbLength;
  if (!(maxScroll > 0) || !(room > 0)) return null;
  const onThumb = pointer >= thumbStart - SCROLLBAR_GRIP && pointer <= thumbStart + thumbLength + SCROLLBAR_GRIP;
  const grab = onThumb ? Math.min(thumbLength, Math.max(0, pointer - thumbStart)) : thumbLength / 2;
  return { grab, pos: dragScrollAt(pointer, grab, trackStart, room, maxScroll) };
}

function dragScrollAt(pointer        , grab        , trackStart        , room        , maxScroll        )         {
  const offset = Math.min(room, Math.max(0, pointer - grab - trackStart));
  return (offset / room) * maxScroll;
}

function enableDrag(el             , bar     )       {

    const thumbRect = bar.thumb.getBoundingClientRect();
    const start = dragScrollPos({
      pointer: vertical ? ev.clientY : ev.clientX,
      trackStart: vertical ? trackRect.top : trackRect.left,
      trackLength: vertical ? trackRect.height : trackRect.width,
      thumbStart: vertical ? thumbRect.top : thumbRect.left,
      thumbLength: vertical ? thumbRect.height : thumbRect.width,
      scrollSize: vertical ? el.scrollHeight : el.scrollWidth,
      clientSize: vertical ? el.clientHeight : el.clientWidth,
    });
    if (!start) return;
    ev.preventDefault();
    ev.stopPropagation();
    const trackStart = vertical ? trackRect.top : trackRect.left;
    const room = (vertical ? trackRect.height : trackRect.width) - (vertical ? thumbRect.height : thumbRect.width);
    const maxScroll = vertical ? el.scrollHeight - el.clientHeight : el.scrollWidth - el.clientWidth;
    const apply = (pos        ) => {
      if (vertical) el.scrollTop = pos;
      else el.scrollLeft = pos;
    };

    const id = ev.pointerId;
    try {
      bar.track.setPointerCapture(id);
    } catch {
    }
    bar.track.classList.add('ed-sb-drag');
    const onMove = (e              ) => {
      if (e.pointerId !== id) return;
      e.preventDefault();
      apply(dragScrollAt(vertical ? e.clientY : e.clientX, start.grab, trackStart, room, maxScroll));
    };
    const onUp = (e              ) => {
      if (e.pointerId !== id) return;
      bar.track.classList.remove('ed-sb-drag');
      bar.track.removeEventListener('pointermove', onMove);
      bar.track.removeEventListener('pointerup', onUp);
      bar.track.removeEventListener('pointercancel', onUp);
    };
    bar.track.addEventListener('pointermove', onMove);
    bar.track.addEventListener('pointerup', onUp);
    bar.track.addEventListener('pointercancel', onUp);
  });
}

function layoutBar(el             , bar     )       {
  const vertical = bar.axis === 'y';
  const scrollSize = vertical ? el.scrollHeight : el.scrollWidth;
  const client = vertical ? el.clientHeight : el.clientWidth;
  const pos = vertical ? el.scrollTop : el.scrollLeft;
  const trackLength = client - SCROLLBAR_INSET * 2;
  const m = thumbMetrics(scrollSize, client, pos, trackLength);
  bar.track.hidden = m.hidden;
  if (m.hidden) return;
  bar.track.style.transform = `translate(${el.scrollLeft}px, ${el.scrollTop}px)`;
  if (vertical) {
    bar.track.style.height = `${trackLength}px`;
    bar.thumb.style.height = `${m.length}px`;
    bar.thumb.style.transform = `translateY(${m.offset}px)`;
  } else {
    bar.track.style.width = `${trackLength}px`;
    bar.thumb.style.width = `${m.length}px`;
    bar.thumb.style.transform = `translateX(${m.offset}px)`;
  }

function attachScrollbar(el             , options                   = {})                  {

    track.className = `ed-sb ed-sb-${axis}`;
    track.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true');
    track.hidden = true;
    const thumb = doc.createElement('i');
    track.appendChild(thumb);
    el.appendChild(track);

    return bar;
  });

  try {
    mq = typeof win.matchMedia === 'function' ? win.matchMedia(SCROLLBAR_MEDIA) : null;
  } catch {
    mq = null;
  }

  let alive = true;
  const update = () => {
    pending = false;
    if (!alive) return;
    const on = force || (mq ? mq.matches : needsCustomBar(win));
    for (const bar of bars) {
      if (bar.track.parentElement !== el) el.appendChild(bar.track);
      if (on) layoutBar(el, bar);

    }
  };
  const schedule = () => {
    if (pending || !alive) return;
    pending = true;
    win.requestAnimationFrame(update);
  };
  const isOwn = (node         ) => node.classList.contains('ed-sb');
  const ro = typeof win.ResizeObserver === 'function' ? new win.ResizeObserver(schedule) : null;

    ro.observe(el);

  };

  const mo =
    typeof win.MutationObserver === 'function'
      ? new win.MutationObserver(records => {

          schedule();

      : null;

  el.addEventListener('scroll', schedule, { passive: true });
  mq?.addEventListener?.('change', schedule);
  update();
  return {
    update: schedule,
    dispose() {
      alive = false;
      ro?.disconnect();
      mo?.disconnect();
      el.removeEventListener('scroll', schedule);
      mq?.removeEventListener?.('change', schedule);
      for (const bar of bars) bar.track.remove();
      el.classList.remove('ed-sb-host', 'ed-sb-force', 'ed-scroll');
    },

}

const handles = new WeakMap                              ();

const scrollbarDirective                                                             = {
  mounted(el, binding) {
    handles.get(el)?.dispose();
    handles.set(el, attachScrollbar(el, binding.value ?? {}));
  },
  updated(el) {
    handles.get(el)?.update();
  },
  unmounted(el) {
    handles.get(el)?.dispose();
    handles.delete(el);
  },
};

function installScrollbar(app     )       {
  app.directive('ed-scrollbar', scrollbarDirective);
}
window.EldredScrollbar = { attachScrollbar, ensureScrollbarStyle, thumbMetrics, needsCustomBar, SCROLLBAR_CSS, SCROLLBAR_MEDIA };
})();

<script data-from="time.js">
(function () {
  'use strict';
  var PERIOD_NAME = { dawn: '清晨', day: '白天', dusk: '黄昏', night: '夜里' };
  function clockPeriod(d) {
    var h = (d || new Date()).getHours();
    return h >= 5 && h < 7 ? 'dawn' : h >= 7 && h < 17 ? 'day' : h >= 17 && h < 19 ? 'dusk' : 'night';
  }
  function seasonOf(m) { return m >= 1 && m <= 3 ? 'spring' : m >= 4 && m <= 6 ? 'summer' : m >= 7 && m <= 9 ? 'autumn' : 'winter'; }

  var TABLE = {
    spring: [['晴', 55], ['多云', 20], ['雨', 20], ['雾', 5]],
    summer: [['晴', 55], ['多云', 15], ['雨', 30]],
    autumn: [['晴', 50], ['多云', 20], ['雨', 15], ['雾', 15]],
    winter: [['晴', 50], ['多云', 20], ['雪', 25], ['雾', 5]]
  };
  function dayKey(d) { return d.getFullYear() * 10000 + (d.getMonth() + 1) * 100 + d.getDate(); }
  function hash01(n) {
    n = (n ^ 61) ^ (n >>> 16); n = (n + (n << 3)) | 0; n ^= n >>> 4; n = Math.imul(n, 0x27d4eb2d); n ^= n >>> 15;
    return (n >>> 0) / 4294967296;
  }
  function rollWeather(d, season) {
    var t = TABLE[season] || TABLE.spring, r = hash01(dayKey(d)) * 100, acc = 0;
    for (var i = 0; i < t.length; i++) { acc += t[i][1]; if (r < acc) return t[i][0]; }
    return t[0][0];
  }

  var TRIAL_KEY = 'eldred-yard2-trial';
  function trial() {
    try { var o = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(TRIAL_KEY) || '{}'); return o && typeof o === 'object' ? o : {}; } catch (e) { return {}; }
  }
  function setTrial(k, v) {
    var o = trial(); o[k] = v;
    try { localStorage.setItem(TRIAL_KEY, JSON.stringify(o)); } catch (e) { }
  }

  function period(useTrial) {
    var p = useTrial ? trial().period : '';
    return PERIOD_NAME[p] ? p : clockPeriod();
  }
  function applyPeriod(useTrial) {
    var p = period(useTrial), el = document.documentElement;
    if (el.getAttribute('data-period') === p) return false;
    el.setAttribute('data-period', p);
    return true;
  }
  function weather(month, useTrial, offset) {
    var d = new Date(); if (offset) d.setDate(d.getDate() + offset);
    var sn = seasonOf(month), w = rollWeather(d, sn);
    if (!offset && useTrial) { var o = trial().weather; if (o === '晴' || o === '雨' || o === '雪') w = o; }
    return w;
  }

  window.YardTime = {
    PERIOD_NAME: PERIOD_NAME,
    clockPeriod: clockPeriod, period: period, applyPeriod: applyPeriod,
    seasonOf: seasonOf, weather: weather, rollWeather: rollWeather,
    trial: trial, setTrial: setTrial,
    fast: function (useTrial) { return !!(useTrial && trial().fast); }
  };
})();

</script>

(function () {
  'use strict';
  var PERIOD_NAME = { dawn: '清晨', day: '白天', dusk: '黄昏', night: '夜里' };
  function clockPeriod(d) {
    var h = (d || new Date()).getHours();
    return h >= 5 && h < 7 ? 'dawn' : h >= 7 && h < 17 ? 'day' : h >= 17 && h < 19 ? 'dusk' : 'night';
  }
  function seasonOf(m) { return m >= 1 && m <= 3 ? 'spring' : m >= 4 && m <= 6 ? 'summer' : m >= 7 && m <= 9 ? 'autumn' : 'winter'; }

  var TABLE = {
    spring: [['晴', 55], ['多云', 20], ['雨', 20], ['雾', 5]],
    summer: [['晴', 55], ['多云', 15], ['雨', 30]],
    autumn: [['晴', 50], ['多云', 20], ['雨', 15], ['雾', 15]],
    winter: [['晴', 50], ['多云', 20], ['雪', 25], ['雾', 5]]
  };
  function dayKey(d) { return d.getFullYear() * 10000 + (d.getMonth() + 1) * 100 + d.getDate(); }
  function hash01(n) {
    n = (n ^ 61) ^ (n >>> 16); n = (n + (n << 3)) | 0; n ^= n >>> 4; n = Math.imul(n, 0x27d4eb2d); n ^= n >>> 15;
    return (n >>> 0) / 4294967296;
  }
  function rollWeather(d, season) {
    var t = TABLE[season] || TABLE.spring, r = hash01(dayKey(d)) * 100, acc = 0;
    for (var i = 0; i < t.length; i++) { acc += t[i][1]; if (r < acc) return t[i][0]; }
    return t[0][0];
  }

  var TRIAL_KEY = 'eldred-yard2-trial';
  function trial() {
    try { var o = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(TRIAL_KEY) || '{}'); return o && typeof o === 'object' ? o : {}; } catch (e) { return {}; }
  }
  function setTrial(k, v) {
    var o = trial(); o[k] = v;
    try { localStorage.setItem(TRIAL_KEY, JSON.stringify(o)); } catch (e) { }
  }

  function period(useTrial) {
    var p = useTrial ? trial().period : '';
    return PERIOD_NAME[p] ? p : clockPeriod();
  }
  function applyPeriod(useTrial) {
    var p = period(useTrial), el = document.documentElement;
    if (el.getAttribute('data-period') === p) return false;
    el.setAttribute('data-period', p);
    return true;
  }
  function weather(month, useTrial, offset) {
    var d = new Date(); if (offset) d.setDate(d.getDate() + offset);
    var sn = seasonOf(month), w = rollWeather(d, sn);
    if (!offset && useTrial) { var o = trial().weather; if (o === '晴' || o === '雨' || o === '雪') w = o; }
    return w;
  }

  window.YardTime = {
    PERIOD_NAME: PERIOD_NAME,
    clockPeriod: clockPeriod, period: period, applyPeriod: applyPeriod,
    seasonOf: seasonOf, weather: weather, rollWeather: rollWeather,
    trial: trial, setTrial: setTrial,
    fast: function (useTrial) { return !!(useTrial && trial().fast); }
  };
})();
